user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: Each vehicle is identified by the Bluetooth MAC address of its on-board device (head unit, hands-free kit...).

person.title: Link a person
person.description: Pick the phone's Bluetooth sensor (Companion app) and the matching person. The vehicle copies the position of the person whose phone is connected to it. If several phones are connected, the first person added wins.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address. Expected format: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_configured: A vehicle with this MAC address is already configured.
